# authwise_access_resource_type (Data Source)

A resource type declared in an audience's Access catalog, such as `guardcontrol.tenant`: its `parent_type` and where the parent edge comes from (`expansion_mode`: `NONE`, `PUSH`, `PULL` or `PATH`). A binding anchored at a parent reaches the resources linked under it. The id is the type's own name. This data source reads one by its full resource name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Full resource name of the object to read.

### Read-Only

- `access_resource_type_id` (String) Caller-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`.
- `audience_id` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `endpoint_name` (String)
- `expansion_mode` (String)
- `issuer_id` (String)
- `materialize_lookup_resources` (Boolean)
- `parent_type` (String)
- `tenant_id` (String)
